_comment: editorconfig-checker config, read by Super-Linter's EDITORCONFIG leg from
LINTER_RULES_PATH (.github/linters). Scoped to this one linter on purpose:
FILTER_REGEX_EXCLUDE in .github/super-linter.env is global, so excluding a
path there would also hide it from JSON validation and gitleaks.
.config/dotnet-tools.json is written by Dependabot's NuGet updater, which
drops the final newline on every tool bump (#277, #279). The file is
machine-written and its syntax is still checked by the JSON leg and by
'dotnet tool restore' failing, so the missing newline carries no meaning -
but it failed the required lint check on every dependency PR.
